scope: sub-04 known released generic THINGS-EEG2 stimuli only. Evaluate the new forward model on disjoint generic objects. No target panel, learned denoiser weights or full-resolution generator run in this stage. Prior results from these objects on other readouts are known.
data: Historical 4x8x8 area-averaged scaled VAE posterior modes, plus the existing parity-verified extension to cover the 512 objects. Four physical trials of all ten photos of every object. Use posterior 17-channel 60-460 ms in 20ms-bin means (340 dimensions). Average source-documented earlier/later trial-pairs separately. Both repeats, supports and query always belong to one known generic object; pair adjacent ordinals into five two-query folds. Use only its other eight photos for residual baselines and proposal selection.
training: Fit only 320 objects. Center latent and each EEG half within each training object. Symmetric inverse square root of latent covariance regularized by 0.1 trace-mean identity; EEG noise covariance from half the difference of session-pair means, whose covariance estimates 4-repeat noise under independent equal-variance halves; use half empirical plus half diagonal with trace floor. Fit standardized within-class latent->noise-whitened R4 EEG ridge 0.3*n. SVD of the linear map. Direct inverse reference fits reversed features on same training set with ridge 0.3*n (not a different preexisting checkpoint).
mode_selection: On the 96 calibration objects, compute held-pair-relative latent/early EEG/late EEG in the first 16 training singular modes. For each mode require the mean per-object cross-products of latent coordinate with *each* independent EEG half to have positive 0.05/(2*16) lower one-sided whole-object bootstrap quantile (seed 260572, 20000 draws). Use every passing mode; allow zero. No basis refit or threshold changes. Positive scalar response a estimated by regressing calibration R4 EEG mode on its true latent mode, zero intercept. r=max(calibration residual variance,half-difference noise variance,1e-8), K=a*var(latent)/(a*a*var(latent)+r).
update: For a candidate latent zc relative to the mean of the eight permitted latent supports, update retained whitened mode coordinates by 0.35*K*(y-a*zc). Map to raw VAE units. Four measured trials of the query minus mean of eight measured supports supply y. Wrong control uses the other held query EEG of the same known object and fold (nonself for every row). Mean control sets y=0 with the same correction; candidate-blind uses 0.35*K*y, omitting a*zc only. Compare unedited candidate and matched fully dimensional direct inverse 0.35 interpolation toward its EEG estimate, and its zero-EEG interpolation. No correction outside the selected forward subspace. The linear update is additive in measured EEG and candidate shape.
proposals: Each of 960 disjoint evaluation queries has two evaluation inputs: the mean of its 8 legal off-fold VAE anchors, and the actual support image (smallest distance to that mean in physical latent Euclidean units, tie input order). This is a clean-latent proposal diagnostic; no authentic denoising trajectory is available here. Both proposals exclude the held-out true latent. After all predictions freeze, inspect the true latent for error and a separate non-deployable Euclidean projection oracle in the physically reachable basis (gain=1 and 0.35 variants).
primary_gate: Before attempting actual diffusion, require >=1 reliable mode; positive lower 95% paired class interval for heldout projected forward EEG squared-error reduction vs zero in BOTH earlier and later halves; positive lower bound for decrease in all-256-coordinate physical VAE MSE after matched medoid correction versus unchanged, same prior, and wrong EEG. For an incremental candidate measurement, matched correction must also beat candidate-blind correction in point MSE and the matched-minus-zero EEG benefit must be at least the equivalent direct inverse matched-minus-zero benefit (point comparison). Fail closes generation without searching ranks, weights or candidate policies.
secondary: Report 96-class paired intervals (seed 260573; 10000 draws); 960 queries, 480 pairs. Measure latent->EEG two-way candidate identity from forward-likelihood with the correct latent only after sealing; report full inverse and oracle upper bounds; report candidate-domain fractions recoverable, retained singular modes and a fold-local null. No generated-pixel or population claim. Conditional subsequent generation would require a native four-step replay, pinned t499 and 0.35 and independent JPEG evaluation.
